16600.meaning1: fact of having arisen; fact of being (in)

examples.text: kāmadadassā'pi, mahārāja, maṇiratanassa ekadesaṃ kakkasaṃ uppajjati, na ca tattha kakkas'uppannattā maṇiratanaṃ hīḷitaṃ nāma hoti. yaṃ tattha parisuddhaṃ maṇiratanassa, taṃ janassa hāsakaraṃ hoti.

cattāro ariyamaggā sayaṃ samucchinnehi kilesehi vimuttattā samucchedavimuttī'ti saṅkhyaṃ gacchan'ti. cattāri sāmaññaphalāni magg'ānubhāvena kilesānaṃ paṭippassaddhante uppannattā paṭippassaddhivimuttī'ti saṅkhyaṃ gacchan'ti.
evañ'ca kho maṃ, āvuso kassapa, pucchitabbaṃ, imehi pana te, āvuso bākula, asītiyā vassehi katikkhattuṃ kāmasaññā uppannapubbā'ti?

16602.meaning1: laden with fruit; full of fruit

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, gahapati, gāmassa vā nigamassa vā avidūre tibbo vanasaṇḍo. tatr'assa rukkho sampannaphalo ca uppannaphalo ca, na c'assu kānici phalāni bhūmiyaṃ patitāni.

16605.commentary: (DNt) tebhūmake saṅkhāre aniccā'ti anupassati etāyā'ti anicc'ānupassanā, tathā pavattā vipassanā, sā pana yasmā attanā sahagatasaññāya bhāvitāya vibhāvitā eva hotī'ti vuttaṃ anicc'ānupassanāya saddhiṃ uppannasaññā'ti.

examples.text: pañcamasattake aniccasaññā'ti anicc'ānupassanāya saddhiṃ uppannasaññā. anattasaññ'ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.
sattam'ādīsu aṭṭhikasaññā'ti aṭṭhikaṃ aṭṭhikan'ti bhāventassa uppannasaññā. taṃ pan'etaṃ bhāvayato yāva nimittaṃ na uppajjati, tāva chavi'pi cammam'pi upaṭṭhāti.
ayam'pi kho, bhikkhave, ān'āpānassatisamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato santo c'eva paṇīto ca asecanako ca sukho ca vihāro uppann'uppanne ca pāpake akusale dhamme ṭhānaso antaradhāpeti vūpasameti.
uppann'uppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāya sammukhāvinayo dātabbo, sativinayo dātabbo, amūḷhavinayo dātabbo, paṭiññāya kāretabbaṃ, yebhuyyasikā, tassapāpiyasikā, tiṇ'avatthārako'ti.

16608.meaning1: what is called the arising of an occasion

16611.meaning2: who has left the community, left the Saṅgha

16614.meaning1: forces to disrobe; expels from the community

examples.text: evaṃ vutte seṭṭhi gahapati, ahaṃ imaṃ uppabbājessāmī'ti ānesiṃ, so dāni me dhammakathaṃ kātuṃ āraddho, ayaṃ na me vacanaṃ karissatī'ti uṭṭhāya gantvā assa orodhānaṃ dvāraṃ vivarāpetvā, ayaṃ vo sāmiko, gacchatha yaṃ kiñci katvā naṃ gaṇhituṃ vāyamathā'ti uyyojesi.

16615.meaning1: having forced to disrobe; having expelled from the community
16615.meaning2: having turned out of the community

examples.text: upālittherappamukhā bhikkhū taṃ bhikkhuniṃ uppabbājetvā mettiyabhūmajake bhikkhū anuyuñjitvā tehi amhehi niyojitā sā bhikkhunī'ti vutte bhagavato ekam'atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.

16616.meaning1: expelling; turning out of the community; disrobing
16616.meaning2: expelling; disrobing; defrocking; turning out of the community

examples.text: brahmacariyavantam'pi itthīhi saddhiṃ sampayojetvā sīlavināsaṃ pāpento balakkārena vā uppabbājento tamhā ṭhānā cāvetuṃ sakkoti.

16617.meaning1: forced to disrobe; expelled from the community

examples.text: rājā paṭhamam'eva samayassa uggahitattā na'y'ime bhikkhū, aññatitthiyā ime'ti ñatvā tesaṃ setakāni vatthāni datvā uppabbājesi. te sabbe'pi saṭṭhisahassā ahesuṃ.

16618.meaning1: blue water lily; (comm) (or) aquatic flower in general
16618.commentary: (ANa) ettha ca setarattanīlesu yaṃkiñci uppalam'eva, ūnakasatapattaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ, satapattaṃ padumaṃ. pattaniyamaṃ vā vinā'pi setaṃ padumaṃ, rattaṃ puṇḍarīkan'ti ayam'ettha vinicchayo. (JAa) uppalan'ti nīl'uppalaṃ.

examples.text: candanaṃ tagaraṃ vā'pi, uppalaṃ atha vassikī, etesaṃ gandhajātānaṃ, sīlagandho anuttaro.
seyyathā'pi, vāhana, uppalaṃ vā padumaṃ vā puṇḍarīkaṃ vā udake jātaṃ udake saṃvaḍḍhaṃ udakā paccuggamma ṭhitaṃ anupalittaṃ udakena.

16620.meaning1: one of the four treasures of a Bodhisatta

examples.text: tathāgatassa pana jātadivase'y'eva saṅkho, elo, uppalo, puṇḍarīko'ti cattāro nidhayo uggatā. tesu saṅkho gāvutiko, elo aḍḍhayojaniko, uppalo tigāvutiko, puṇḍarīko yojaniko. tesu'pi gahitaṃ gahitaṃ pūrati'y'eva, iti bhagavā pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ ohāya pabbajito'ti veditabbo.

16621.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: jeto jayanto padumo uppalo ca, padum'uttaro rakkhito pabbato ca, mānatthaddho sobhito vītarāgo, kaṇho ca buddho suvimuttacitto.

16624.meaning1: scent of a blue water lily; lily's perfume
16624.commentary: (DNa) uppalagandho vāyatī'ti hasitakathitakālesu mukhato taṅ'khaṇaṃ vikasitass'eva nīl'uppalassa atisurabhigandho vāyati.

examples.text: tassa kho pan'ānanda, itthiratanassa sīte uṇhāni gattāni honti, uṇhe sītāni. tassa kho pan'ānanda, itthiratanassa kāyato candanagandho vāyati, mukhato uppalagandho.

16625.commentary: (VINa) gandhan'ti hadayaṃ vuccati, taṃ uppāṭentī'ti uppalagandhā, uppalagandhā eva paccatthikā uppalagandhapaccatthikā. ete kira na kasivaṇijjādīhi jīvanti, panthaghātagāmaghāt'ādīni katvā puttadāraṃ posenti. te kammasiddhiṃ patthayamānā devatānaṃ āyācetvā tāsaṃ balikamm'atthaṃ manussānaṃ hadayaṃ uppāṭenti. sabbakāle ca manussā dullabhā. bhikkhū pana araññe viharantā sulabhā honti. te sīlavantaṃ bhikkhuṃ gahetvā, sīlavato vadho nāma bhāriyo hotī'ti maññamānā tassa sīlavināsan'atthaṃ manuss'itthi'ādike vā ānenti, taṃ vā tattha nenti. ayam'ettha viseso.

16626.meaning1: (comm) part of the Avīci hell where one must stay an uppala-count in duration

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, vīsati kumudā nirayā, evam'eko sogandhiko nirayo. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, vīsati sogandhikā nirayā, evam'eko uppalanirayo. seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, vīsati uppalā nirayā, evam'eko puṇḍariko nirayo.

16627.meaning1: leaf of a blue water lily
16627.commentary: (VINa) antamaso uppalapattenāpī'ti ettha pattaṃ tāva mahantaṃ, kesarenā'pi pahāraṃ dentiyā āpatti'y'eva.

examples.text: pahāraṃ dadeyyā'ti kāyena vā kāyapaṭibaddhena vā nissaggiyena vā antamaso uppalapattena'pi pahāraṃ deti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
talasattikaṃ uggireyyā'ti kāyaṃ vā kāyapaṭibaddhaṃ vā antamaso uppalapattam'pi uccāreti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
seyyathā'pi, āvuso, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko sīsaṃnhāto uppalamālaṃ vā vassikamālaṃ vā atimuttakamālaṃ vā labhitvā ubhohi hatthehi paṭiggahetvā uttam'aṅge sirasmiṃ patiṭṭhapeyya

16629.meaning1: like the tips of blue water lilies

examples.text: uppalasikhar'opamāni te, vimale hāṭakasannibhe mukhe, tava me nayanāni dakkhiya, bhiyyo kāmaguṇo pavaḍḍhati.

16630.meaning1: name of an arahant nun; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost nun in psychic ability
16630.synonym: khemā, paṭācārā, bakulā, mahāpajāpati, mahāpajāpatigotamī, mahāpajāpatī, sigālamātar, siṅgālakamātar, siṅgālamātar
16630.commentary: (VINa) uppalavaṇṇā'ti sā therī sāvatthiyaṃ seṭṭhidhītā satasahassakappe abhinīhārasampannā. tassā pakatiyā'pi atidassanīyā nīl'uppalavaṇṇā kāyacchavi, abbhantare pana kilesasantāpassa abhāvena ativiya virocati. sā tā'y'eva vaṇṇapokkharatāya uppalavaṇṇā'ti nāmaṃ labhi. (ANa) uppalavaṇṇā'ti nīl'uppalagabbhasadisen'eva vaṇṇena samannāgatattā evaṃladdhanāmā therī. sā kira padum'uttarabuddhakāle haṃsavatiyaṃ kulagehe paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhitvā aparabhāge mahājanena saddhiṃ satthu santikaṃ gantvā dhammaṃ suṇantī satthāraṃ ekaṃ bhikkhuniṃ iddhimantīnaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā satt'āhaṃ buddhappamukhassa bhikkhusaṅghassa mahādānaṃ datvā taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ patthesi. sā yāvajīvaṃ kusalaṃ katvā devamanussesu saṃsarantī kassapabuddhakāle bārāṇasinagare kikissa kāsirañño gehe paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhitvā sattannaṃ bhaginīnaṃ abbhantarā hutvā vīsati vassasahassāni brahmacariyaṃ caritvā bhikkhusaṅghassa pariveṇaṃ katvā devaloke nibbattā.
16630.notes: Therīgāthā verses 224-235 (TH11.1, TH64) are attributed to her.

examples.text: ajj'aṭṭhamī pabbajitā, saddhā saddhammasobhanā, vinīt'uppalavaṇṇāya, tevijjā maccuhāyinī.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ iddhimantīnaṃ yadidaṃ uppalavaṇṇā.

16633.meaning2: swims (up); floats, floats around; leaps up, jumps; is frisky, excited

examples.text: pañca uppalahatthāni, āveḷatthaṃ ahaṃsu me, tena buddhaṃ apūjesiṃ, pasanno sehi pāṇibhi.

16635.meaning2: pond or lake full of water lilies

examples.text: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā app'ekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā

16636.commentary: (VINa) gandhan'ti hadayaṃ vuccati, taṃ uppāṭentī'ti uppalagandhā, uppalagandhā eva paccatthikā uppalagandhapaccatthikā. ete kira na kasivaṇijjādīhi jīvanti, panthaghātagāmaghāt'ādīni katvā puttadāraṃ posenti. te kammasiddhiṃ patthayamānā devatānaṃ āyācetvā tāsaṃ balikamm'atthaṃ manussānaṃ hadayaṃ uppāṭenti. sabbakāle ca manussā dullabhā. bhikkhū pana araññe viharantā sulabhā honti. te sīlavantaṃ bhikkhuṃ gahetvā, sīlavato vadho nāma bhāriyo hotī'ti maññamānā tassa sīlavināsan'atthaṃ manuss'itthi'ādike vā ānenti, taṃ vā tattha nenti. ayam'ettha viseso.

16637.commentary: (SNa) uppāṭakehi sañchanno'ti uppāṭakapāṇakehi sañchanno. tassa kira brāhmaṇassa sayan'atthāya santhataṃ tiṇapaṇṇasanthāraṃ koci antar'antarā paṭijagganto n'atthi. so divasaṃ araññe kammaṃ katvā sāyaṃ āgantvā tasmiṃ nipajjati. ath'assa uppāṭakapāṇakā sarīraṃ ekacchannaṃ karontā khādanti, taṃ gahetvā evam'āha. (SNt) uppāṭakapāṇakā'ti tacaṃ uppāṭetvā viya khādakapāṇakā ūkāmaṅgul'ādayo.

examples.text: na hi nūn'imassa samaṇassa, santhāro sattamāsiko, uppāṭakehi sañchanno, ten'āyaṃ samaṇo sukhī.

16640.meaning2: doing the work of uprooting or skinning

16643.meaning2: at the moment it was torn out

examples.text: uppāṭiya cārudassanā, na ca pajjittha asaṅgamānasā, handa te cakkhuṃ harassu taṃ, tassa narassa adāsi tāva'd'e.

16647.meaning1: having split open; having removed the skin

examples.text: atha kho jīvako komārabhacco seṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ mañcake nipātetvā sambandhitvā sīsacchaviṃ uppāṭetvā sibbiniṃ vināmetvā dve pāṇake nīharitvā mahājanassa dassesi.
jīvako… janaṃ ussāretvā tirokaraṇiyaṃ parikkhipitvā thambhe upanibandhitvā bhariyaṃ purato ṭhapetvā udaracchaviṃ uppāṭetvā antagaṇṭhiṃ nīharitvā bhariyāya dassesi

16648.meaning2: having torn out; having rooted out; having removed

examples.text: atha kho so puriso taṃ itthiṃ dvidhā chetvā attānaṃ uppāṭesi, ubho pecca bhavissāmā'ti. iminā'pi kho etaṃ, brāhmaṇa, pariyāyena veditabbaṃ yathā piyajātikā soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā piyappabhavikā'ti.
so ānetha me, puttan'ti daḷhaṃ gahetvā tassa viravantassa dantehi phalāni uppāṭesi.
uppātesu nimittesu, lakkhaṇesu ca kovidaṃ, ajjhāyakaṃ mantadharaṃ, porohicce ṭhapeti so.
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… akkharappabhedaṃ padaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ bhāsamaggaṃ uppātaṃ supinaṃ nimittaṃ chaḷaṅgaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā

16652.meaning1: split open; cut open; sliced open
16652.meaning2: split open; cut open; sliced open

examples.text: atha kho sā brāhmaṇī satthaṃ gahetvā ovarakaṃ pavisitvā udaraṃ uppātesi, yāva vijāyāmi yadi vā kumārako yadi vā kumārikā'ti. sā attānaṃ c'eva jīvitañ'ca gabbhañ'ca sāpateyyañ'ca vināsesi.

16653.commentary: (ANa) uppādo'ti jāti. vayo'ti bhedo. (DHPa) buddhānam'uppādo'ti yasmā buddhā uppajjamānā mahājanaṃ rāgakantār'ādīhi tārenti, tasmā buddhānaṃ uppādo sukho uttamo.

examples.text: kiccho manussapaṭilābho, kicchaṃ maccāna jīvitaṃ, kicchaṃ saddhammassavanaṃ, kiccho buddhānam'uppādo.
yathā ca anuppannassa kāmacchandassa uppādo hoti tañ'ca pajānāti

16654.meaning1: sudden event; strange occurrence; comet; meteor; disaster

examples.text: yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… bhūmikampaṃ disādāhaṃ bhumm'antalikkhaṃ jotisaṃ lok'āyatikaṃ sācakkaṃ migacakkaṃ antaracakkaṃ missak'uppādaṃ sakuṇarutaravitaṃ sikkhā karaṇīyā

16655.commentary: (VINa) lohit'uppādako bhikkhave'ti etthā'pi yo devadatto viya duṭṭhacittena vadhakacittena tathāgatassa jīvamānakasarīre khuddakamakkhikāya pivanakamattam'pi lohitaṃ uppādeti, ayaṃ lohit'uppādako nāma.

examples.text: saṅghabhedako, bhikkhave, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo'ti. lohit'uppādako, bhikkhave, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo, upasampanno nāsetabbo'ti.

16659.meaning1: skilled in strange events and omens

examples.text: paññāpaṭilābhagatena kammunā, manussabhūto sukhumacchavī ahu, byākaṃsu uppādanimittakovidā, sukhumāni atthāni avecca dakkhiti.

16660.meaning1: produces; generates; causes; gives rise to
16660.synonym: āpādeti, janeti, nipphādeti, pasavati, pātukaroti, savati

examples.text: yadapi luddho lobhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto parassa asatā dukkhaṃ uppādayati.

16661.meaning1: producing; generating; causing; giving rise to
16661.synonym: janaka, janana, janika, janiya, ṭhāniya, samuṭṭhāpaka, samuṭṭhāpayamāna

examples.text: tasmā lobhañ'ca dosañ'ca, mohajañ'c'āpi viddasu, vijjaṃ uppādayaṃ bhikkhu, sabbā duggatiyo jaheti.

16665.meaning2: Chapter 1 of the Uppādasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 26 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

16666.meaning1: arising and passing; appearing and disappearing; coming and going; appearance and dissolution

examples.text: na tvaṃ bāle pajānāsi, yathā arahataṃ vaco, aniccā sabbasaṅkhārā, uppādavayadhammino, uppajjitvā nirujjhanti, tesaṃ vūpasamo sukho'ti.

16667.meaning1: liable to arise and pass; prone to appearing and disappearing
16667.meaning2: liable to arise and pass way; prone to appearing and disappearing

examples.text: tassā'y'eva adukkham'asukhāya vedanāya nirodhā byagā me attā'ti hoti. iti so diṭṭh'eva dhamme aniccasukhadukkhavokiṇṇaṃ uppādavayadhammaṃ attānaṃ samanupassamāno samanupassati, yo so evam'āha, vedanā me attā'ti.

16668.meaning1: marked by arising and passing away; with the nature of appearing and disappearing

examples.text: na tvaṃ bāle pajānāsi, yathā arahataṃ vaco, aniccā sabbasaṅkhārā, uppādavayadhammino, uppajjitvā nirujjhanti, tesaṃ vūpasamo sukho'ti.
imañ'ca me puttaphalaṃ, kāḷa uppāditaṃ tayā, taṃ maṃ puttavatiṃ santiṃ, kassa ohāya gacchasi.
paṇḍito uppāditadhanañ'ca, ābhatadhanañ'ca sabbaṃ tassā mātāpitūnaṃ datvā samassāsetvā sasure āpucchitvā taṃ ādāya nagar'ābhimukho agamāsi.

16672.meaning1: (abhi) having the nature to arise; bound to arise
16672.meaning2: having nature to arise; bound to arise

examples.text: uppannā dhammā. anuppannā dhammā. uppādino dhammā.

16673.meaning1: should be produced; should be generated
16673.meaningLit: to cause to be gone up

examples.text: eko, āvuso, dhammo bahukāro, eko dhammo bhāvetabbo, eko dhammo pariññeyyo, eko dhammo pahātabbo, eko dhammo hānabhāgiyo, eko dhammo visesabhāgiyo, eko dhammo duppaṭivijjho, eko dhammo uppādetabbo, eko dhammo abhiññeyyo, eko dhammo sacchikātabbo.
katamo eko dhammo uppādetabbo? akuppaṃ ñāṇaṃ. ayaṃ eko dhammo uppādetabbo.

16676.grammar: masc, agent, from uppādeti, caus (+acc or +gen)
16676.commentary: (MNa) tesu pāpakaṃ cittaṃ uppādetā'ti. na mayā tesu pāpakaṃ cittam'pi uppāditan'ti attho.

examples.text: na kho pan'āhaṃ, sāriputta, abhijānāmi tesu pāpakaṃ cittaṃ uppādetā. idaṃsu me, sāriputta, upekkhāvihārasmiṃ hoti.

tathāgato, bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā, asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā, anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā maggaññū, maggavidū, maggakovido, magg'ānugā ca, bhikkhave, eta'r'ahi sāvakā viharanti pacchāsamannāgatā.

16677.meaning1: produces; generates; causes; gives rise to
16677.synonym: āpādeti, janeti, nipphādeti, pasavati, pātukaroti, savati

examples.text: iti purāṇañ'ca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāma navañ'ca vedanaṃ na uppādessāma yātrā ca no bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsu vihāro cā'ti
upadhi dukkhassa mūlan'ti, iti viditvā nirupadhi upadhisaṅkhaye vimutto upadhismiṃ vā kāyaṃ upasaṃharissati cittaṃ vā uppādessatī'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

16678.meaning1: wishing to produce; wishing to arouse

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā uppalavaṇṇāya bhikkhuniyā bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetu'kāmo samādhimhā cāvetu'kāmo yena uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī ten'upasaṅkami

16679.meaning1: to produce; to generate; to cause; to give rise to

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā uppalavaṇṇāya bhikkhuniyā bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetu'kāmo samādhimhā cāvetu'kāmo yena uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī ten'upasaṅkami

16680.meaning1: having produced; having given rise to
16680.meaning2: having produced, having made, having given rise to

examples.text: so sabbaso rāg'ānusayaṃ pahāya paṭigh'ānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā asmī'ti diṭṭhimān'ānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti

16681.meaning1: producing; generating; causing; giving rise to

16682.meaning1: produced; generated; caused; gave rise to

examples.text: brāhmaṇassa asiṃ ākaḍḍhitvā upasiṅghantassa maricacuṇṇāni nāsaṃ pavisitvā khipitu'kāmataṃ uppādesuṃ. tassa khipantassa nāsikā asidhārāya paṭihatā dvidhā chijji.

16683.commentary: (MNa) uppilan'ti mayā diṭṭhabhayaṃ pakatiyā olokiyamānaṃ n'atthi. adiṭṭhe kiṃ nāma bhayan'ti cintayato uppilāvitattaṃ udapādi.

examples.text: so'haṃ tathā karissāmi yathā me puna na vicikicchā uppajjissati, na amanasikāro, na thinamiddhaṃ, na chambhitattaṃ, na uppilan'ti.

16685.meaning1: due to elation; because of exhilaration

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, anuruddhā, puriso ekaṃ nidhimukhaṃ gavesanto saki'd'eva pañcanidhimukhāni adhigaccheyya, tassa tatonidānaṃ uppilaṃ uppajjeyya, evam'eva kho me, anuruddhā, uppilaṃ udapādi, uppil'ādhikaraṇañ'ca pana me samādhi cavi.

16686.grammar: pp of caus of ud √plu, caus
16686.commentary: (VIBHt) uppilāvitan'ti udaggatāsaṅkhāto avūpasamabhāvo, avūpasamahetubhūto vā pītiyā ākāro.

examples.text: mamaṃ vā, bhikkhave, pare vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, dhammassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, saṅghassa vā vaṇṇaṃ bhāseyyuṃ, tatra ce tumhe assatha ānandino sumanā uppilāvitā tumhaṃ yev'assa tena antarāyo.

16687.construction:
ud + pilāve + ita + tta
uppilāvita + tta

examples.text: tatra ce, bhikkhave, pare tathāgataṃ sakkaronti garuṃ karonti mānenti pūjenti, tatra, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa na hoti ānando na somanassaṃ na cetaso uppilāvitattaṃ.

yath'eva hi nisabhasaṅkhāto usabho usabhabalena samannāgato catūhi pādehi pathaviṃ uppīḷetvā acalaṭṭhānena tiṭṭhati, evaṃ tathāgato'pi dasahi tathāgatabalehi samannāgato catūhi vesārajjapādehi aṭṭhaparisapathaviṃ uppīḷetvā sadevake loke kenaci paccatthikena paccāmittena akampiyo acalaṭṭhānena tiṭṭhati.

16698.meaning2: swims (up); floats, floats around; leaps up, jumps; is frisky, excited

16699.meaning2: having split open; having opened up
